title: Internal test hostname fails DNS resolution
alert_or_symptom: An internal pre-release testing hostname no longer resolves through the organisation's authoritative DNS, while all production customer hostnames remain available.

technical_evidence.observation: The hostname preview-internal.example.test returned NXDOMAIN on all twelve internal resolution checks between 15:02 and 15:12.
Queries for preview-internal.example.test reached the authoritative DNS service and were answered with NXDOMAIN. The requested hostname is not present in the currently served zone data.
Production customer DNS records, CDN distributions and load-balancer health checks remain available and within normal operating thresholds.
Six engineers cannot access the internal preview environment through its normal hostname. They can continue urgent validation using the approved direct internal load-balancer address.
The directly observed failure is DNS resolution for one internal test hostname. The reason the hostname is absent from the served zone data has not yet been established.

service_impact.user_impact_description: Six engineers cannot reach one internal preview environment through its normal DNS hostname. Production customer services and hostnames are unaffected.
service_impact.workaround_description: The approved direct internal load-balancer address can be used for urgent preview validation while DNS resolution is investigated.

environmental_context: The affected hostname is used only for an internal pre-release test environment.
The test environment does not process production customer transactions.
All production DNS records, CDN distributions and load balancers remain healthy.
No customer-facing service impact has been reported.
reported_unknowns: Why the internal test hostname is absent from the currently served authoritative DNS zone data.
Whether the record was removed, expired or omitted during an earlier approved DNS-zone process.
The expected time for the hostname to be restored through the normal change-controlled process.
additional_context: No production outage, customer impact, data loss, corruption or serious security exposure has been identified.
The workaround is approved for internal testing only and does not require any production change.
